(given applicable `view_opportunity` privilege). This is for Grantors
and may contain additional fields that are hidden for Applicants.

`GET /v1/grantors/opportunities/{opportunity_id}`

[Issue #8658] Change workflow to have a single entity (#8659)

## Summary
Fixes #8658 

## Changes proposed
* Remove the one-to-many entity relationships from the workflow table
* Change workflows to instead have a single workflow entity object that
can have exactly one entity associated with it.

## Context for reviewers
This PR goes against my own rule - never mix DB changes with code
changes. But as we haven't actually deployed this code anywhere yet, and
the only way to not mix them would require basically removing the
workflow logic, I'll break my own rule.

We've had discussions in a few places about this work, but this largely
boils down to simplifying a whole bunch of logic (most of this PR is
simplifying logic and a lot of test simplification).

## Validation steps
The instructions added next to the check constraint are from my own
testing of adding additional columns later. Alembic cannot detect check
constraints (there's not even an extension I could find, other
constraints sure, but not these). So we have to manage this one
manually, tried to make that abundantly clear to anyone looking at the
model.
